title: The site is back. What broke it, in plain words

text: It was down for about four minutes. Two bugs stacked. First: a minion's unfinished change to the reload code crashed the new server the moment it started; it was a mistake that only shows when the server runs, so the check that a file parses passed it. Your restart picked that up. Second: when the minion saved its fix, the new self-restart program said restarting and then waited for the crashed server to finish dying, which a dead program never does, so nothing came back until you restarted by hand. Both are fixed. The auditor is being woken now with the full timeline, to say why a server change was never started and checked before going live, and what stops it for good. My first answer: the self-restart program must try a changed server on a spare port first, and only swap it in if it answers.
